name: js8
upstream: JS8Call (js8call/js8call) commit a7ff1be0b389d287fdc56e2ea0d06962aa68127d, receive side only

options.--modes: speeds to decode, letters from A (Normal, 15 s), B (Fast, 10 s), C (Turbo, 6 s), E (Slow, 30 s), I (Ultra, 4 s, disabled in JS8Call itself); default ABCE
options.--start-time: UTC of the first sample, in seconds since 1970 (fractions allowed); periods are aligned to UTC multiples of their length; default 0, meaning the first sample is a period boundary
options.--text-events: also print a reserved 'text' event for every frame
